notes: «بلغني» is a gap marker and an unnamed link in its place; the next name after «عن» is جابر بن عبد الله, the Companion, who heard the Prophet
no Jabir b. Zayd is written in this text; the HKG context lists one and is filed as a fix

fixes.reason: HKG places جابر بن زيد between the gap and the Companion, but the text writes بلغني straight before جابر بن عبد الله, with no Jabir b. Zayd.

evidence.quote: بلغني عن جابر بن عبد الله
